# The Xtensa toolchain this project builds with, as README.md records it.
#
# The firmware job caches `.tools/` (1.6 GB of toolchain) under a hash of this
# file, and fails when the toolchain it installed reports anything else; a
# cache keyed only by "latest" is how a build starts depending on the day.
xtensa-rust 1.97.0.0
espup 0.19.0
ldproxy 0.3.4
